game.title: Persona 5 Royal
game.blurb: Expanded edition of the Persona 5 RPG, from Atlus, released 2020-03-31. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours (far under a full run). Genres: Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Palaces
chapters.summary: The main story, Palace by Palace, from the Castle of Lust to the Cruiser of Pride and the end of the year. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mementos and the Reaper
chapters.summary: Mementos requests, flowers and stamps, deviations, changing its cognition, and the Reaper.

chapters.title: Personas and Combat
chapters.summary: Negotiating for Personas, Baton Passes, Technicals, Showtime attacks, Treasure Demons and gun mods.

chapters.title: The Velvet Room
chapters.summary: Executions, Lockdown training with Incense and the Fusion Alarm.

chapters.title: Confidants and School Life
chapters.summary: Exams, social stats, Confidants and hangouts.

chapters.title: Tokyo Life and Pastimes
chapters.summary: Leblanc, part-time jobs, batting cages, darts, billiards, fishing and other spots around Tokyo.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1687950)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Persona_5_Royal
Fandom (megamitensei.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Persona_5_Royal
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; Prologue and two story-arc subpages are written (about 12,000 characters together), but most of the walkthrough is not, so no structure was taken from it. megamitensei.fandom.com answers the API, with about 500 linked pages (the API limit); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Fiber" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1687950. 10 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden; seven are named after Palaces and three ("The Thorough Trickster", "Take Back the Future", "The Path Chosen") are likely late-story beats, all in the Palaces chapter. "Awakening the Phantom Thieves" (evolving a party member's Persona) went to combat, though it may come from Confidants.
